title: Matterbridge Tapo Plugin
description: matterbridge-tapo by Tamer Salah. Enter the email and password of your TP-Link account (Tapo/Kasa app); devices on your network are found automatically.

email.title: TP-Link email
email.description: The email you log in to the Tapo or Kasa app with (case-sensitive)

password.title: TP-Link password
password.description: The password of that account (case-sensitive). It is only used on your network to log in to your devices.

discovery.title: Find devices automatically
discovery.description: Look for Tapo devices on the local network at startup

hosts.title: Device IP addresses
hosts.description: IP addresses of Tapo/Kasa devices to add even if discovery does not find them (e.g. 192.168.68.50). Give them a fixed IP in your router.

refreshInterval.title: Refresh interval
refreshInterval.description: How often (in seconds) to read the state of your devices. Minimum 10, 0 disables polling.

hubRefreshInterval.title: Hub sensor refresh interval
hubRefreshInterval.description: How often (in seconds) to read sensors behind a Tapo hub (door, motion, temperature). Minimum 1, 0 disables the quick reads.

motionHoldTime.title: Motion hold time
motionHoldTime.description: How long (in seconds) a motion sensor stays 'motion detected' after the last movement

sirenSwitch.title: Hub siren as a switch
sirenSwitch.description: Show the siren of Tapo hubs (H100, H200, H500) as a separate switch, e.g. 'Hub Siren'. Off by default: a 'turn everything on' command would start the siren.

sirenSound.title: Siren sound
sirenSound.description: Optional: the siren sound as named in the Tapo app, e.g. 'Alarm 1'. Empty keeps the hub's setting.

sirenVolume.title: Siren volume
sirenVolume.description: Optional: 1 (quiet) to 10 (loud). Empty keeps the hub's setting.

sirenDuration.title: Siren duration
sirenDuration.description: Optional: how many seconds the siren sounds before stopping by itself. Empty keeps the hub's setting.

lightList.description: Expose these plugs/switches (names or device IDs) as lights instead of outlets

whiteList.description: Only expose devices with these names or device IDs (empty exposes all)

blackList.description: Never expose devices with these names or device IDs

debug.description: Enable debug logging for the plugin

unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown (development only)
